_doc: Measured carriageway widths (2026-11 survey on the NLSC 2024 orthophoto, WMTS PHOTO2 z20, about 0.14 m/px; cross-sections rotated along each road with a metre ruler, kerb to kerb including 機慢車道 and kerbside parking, excluding sidewalks, 騎樓, medians and ditches; the biggest changes re-measured blind by a second surveyor). tools/build_map.py apply_roads() sets each OSM way's w (and lanes where given) after the block fill and the grade separations; 'was' is the width OSM / the class default gave, checked on every build. Only widths that differ by 0.8 m or more are listed. 'measured' entries come from cuts on that road; class entries (source says 同類道路) use the typical width of a measured sample of the same kind of lane.
